description: Free, browser-based online calculators and developer utilities for salary, finance, taxes, JSON, JWT, PDFs, and everyday productivity. Privacy-first architecture with client-side execution.

resources.description: Suite of Indian finance, taxation, and investment calculators including EMI, GST, TDS, PF/ESI, and SIP.
representativeQueries: Calculate home loan EMI for 50 Lakh over 20 years
Generate GST invoice with CGST and SGST
Calculate EPF and ESI employee employer contributions with statutory ceiling

resources.description: Salary take-home, payslip generator, gratuity, and job offer evaluation tools for Indian employment structures.
representativeQueries: Calculate in-hand monthly salary from 12 LPA CTC under new tax regime
Generate itemized payslip with basic, HRA, PF, ESI, professional tax and TDS
Calculate gratuity payout for 5 years of service

resources.description: Browser-native developer tools for data conversion, formatting, encoding, and tokens without sending data to servers.
representativeQueries: Decode JWT token claims, algorithm, and expiry timestamp
Convert Unix timestamp to human-readable date in IST and UTC

resources.description: Business workflows including GSTR-2B vs purchase register reconciliation, bank reconciliation, and multi-file Excel data processing.
representativeQueries: Reconcile purchase register against GSTR-2B statement matching GSTIN and taxable amount
Compare bank statement against cash book ledger
Batch transform and clean multiple spreadsheet files in browser

resources.description: Private, client-side PDF manipulation tools including merge, split, extract, compression, and image conversion.
representativeQueries: Merge multiple PDF documents client-side without upload
Compress PDF file size securely in browser
Convert PDF pages to high-resolution JPG images
